meta.source: Mog — Design Language Bible and UI Kit; direction decided 11 Nov 2026

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: App background. Warm ivory. Every neutral below is mixed to sit on it.

tokens.name: surface-50
tokens.usage: Cards, task rows, sheets.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Quiet grounds: locked cards, info panels, the scan countdown. Depth without shadow.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty progress — range tracks, week pips, unfilled rings.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Primary text, score numerals, the dark primary button. Every score uses this, high or low.

tokens.name: ink-700
tokens.usage: Secondary text and body copy.

tokens.name: ink-500
tokens.usage: Tertiary text, captions, section labels. 4.6:1 on paper.

tokens.name: ink-300
tokens.usage: Disabled, unchecked rings, inactive marks. Non-text only.

tokens.name: line-200
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers, 1.5px on cards. Carries all depth in place of shadow.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Measurement — the overlay line, metric markers, the current path node — and the primary button. One accent element per card.

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: The 4px bottom lip on a primary button, and link hover.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: The typical-range band on a track; the 'why this' panel; a selected option's ground.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Text for done and improved: 'Done today', a delta that moved the right way. 5.4:1 on white. Never means a good score.

tokens.name: positive-fill
tokens.usage: Filled check circles, banked path nodes, the day-complete ring. Graphical only — fails as small text.

tokens.name: positive-wash
tokens.usage: Ground behind a done or improved state.

tokens.name: flame
tokens.usage: The streak flame icon and nothing else. Graphical only.

tokens.name: flame-text
tokens.usage: The streak count beside the flame. 4.9:1 on white.

tokens.name: flame-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of the streak pill and streak tile.

tokens.name: finish
tokens.usage: The week-8 trophy node on the path. The only other warm accent in the product, and it appears once.

tokens.name: bronze
tokens.usage: The wordmark tick. Brand mark only.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: A capture gate that is failing; a metric not measured. System state, never score.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Delete everything. The only red in the product.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight grouping; gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen margin; hero-card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gap; bottom safe-area padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Above a display headline.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Top bar height; option-row minimum height.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Blur plates behind locked values; range markers.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small inline buttons inside a card.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, task rows, buttons, option rows, info panels. The workhorse.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero cards: the photo frame, the capture viewport, the scan-day card.

tokens.name: radius-card-stack
tokens.usage: The swipe stack only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, chips, check circles, path nodes, the shutter ring.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every card and row edge.

tokens.name: lip
tokens.usage: The bottom edge of anything pressable — primary and secondary buttons, option rows, tappable task rows. A chunky button is hairline on three sides and lip on the bottom, in a darker shade of its fill.

tokens.name: emphasis
tokens.usage: A selected option, the consent panel, the model-updated card.

tokens.name: instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback, gate chip state changes. Cross-fade, no movement.

tokens.name: quick
tokens.usage: Sheet presentation, toasts.

tokens.name: standard
tokens.usage: Navigation, overlay metric transitions, swipe-stack advance.

tokens.name: deliberate
tokens.usage: The reveal and the day-complete ring. Nowhere else.
